## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible behavior. Link a related
issue if there is one. Include before/after screenshots for UI changes.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results, or explain why a check does not
apply. For documentation, check links and rendered output. For extraction or
export changes, include a reproducible example and reviewed expected values.

## Limitations and provenance

Describe any remaining limitation. If you added an image or dataset, include
its source and reuse basis. Remove this section if it does not apply.
